name: A Shrunken Head
summary: A shrunken head from Feralas is promised to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar. It will secure the herbs needed for an experiment.

sections.title: A Grim Bargain
sections.body: Before the herbs can be put to use, Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar is owed a grim payment. The head came from a dwarf found in the forests of Feralas. Its bearer carries it to the Cleft of Shadow, where Neeru has prepared an herb mixture for Uzer'i's experiments.

faq.answer: The head belonged to a dwarf found in the forests of Feralas.

faq.q: Who is supposed to receive it?
faq.answer: Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar is promised the head.

faq.q: Why does Neeru want the head?
faq.answer: The head is payment for herbs Neeru prepared for Uzer'i's experiments.

faq.q: Where do I take the shrunken head?
faq.answer: Take the shrunken head to Neeru Fireblade in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.
